headline: A Toxic Work World: Q. and A. With Anne-Marie Slaughter
snippet: How can people balance caregiving with career? The author responds to reader questions following her Sunday Review essay.

headline: Anne-Marie Slaughter’s ‘Unfinished Business’
snippet: “Unfinished Business” is the outgrowth of a much-discussed article for The Atlantic about the difficulty of career advancement for professional women with children.
